# Welcome

I am an independent researcher and retired statistician, based in Porto. I work on retirement and pension systems as complex adaptive systems, using agent-based modelling and social simulation.

My doctoral research, begun in the International Doctoral Programme in Complexity Sciences ([Iscte-IUL](https://www.iscte-iul.pt/) / [FCUL](https://ciencias.ulisboa.pt/en)), models retirement timing as an emergent property of interacting workers, pension rules and demographic change. The programme was discontinued in 2025; I am completing the dissertation, *Dynamics of Retirement Pension Systems: A Generational Approach*, independently.

Before that I spent 34 years at [Statistics Portugal (INE)](https://www.ine.pt), most recently responsible for the [Well-being Index of Portugal](https://www.ine.pt/xportal/xmain?xpid=INE&xpgid=ine_indbemestar).
